decisions.reason: The accepted C94598 part is for the passive buzzer and does not change the battery connector family, part number, pin functions, or unresolved pin order.
Selecting the passive buzzer part does not change the independently selected ESP32-S3 module or its LCSC part number.
The source accepts a buzzer part and does not alter the LED daughterboard's selected LED component or board configuration.
The buzzer-part acceptance does not change the USB-C connector selection, compatibility, or availability requirements.
The selected buzzer part has no necessary effect on the addressable LED part, power supply, GPIO, or data-level interface.
The passive buzzer selection does not change the charge-status display, external charge-LED connector, or associated resistor population.
The accepted buzzer component does not alter any interboard connector type, pinout, signal, or power-distribution rule.
This candidate concerns power-board BOM completeness and capacitor part numbers; the source does not state any change to that BOM requirement.
Selecting buzzer part C94598 does not change native USB data lines, enumeration, or the programming-port role.
The buzzer-part decision does not affect the SPS30 connector, cable compatibility, supply, or I2C-mode pinout.
Acceptance of one buzzer part does not modify the general policy of preferring suitable Basic or standard passive components to reduce assembly fees.
